test_title: SSC CGL Tier-II 2023 Official Paper-I (Held On: 26 Oct, 2023)
subject: general
question: Which statement best reflects a fact mentioned in the given passage?

options.text: The Sapphire-winged Warbler is the largest bird species in the avian kingdom.
Schools on the island organise annual bird-watching competitions.
The Sapphire-winged Warbler is the only bird species on the tropical island.
Researchers are using satellite tracking devices to study the bird's migratory patterns.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4** i.e.* Researchers are using satellite tracking devices to study the bird's migratory patterns.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **passage explicitly mentions **that researchers have equipped the Sapphire-winged Warbler with satellite tracking devices to study its migratory patterns.
 
• This is a **verifiable fact** stated directly in the passage.

Therefore, the **correct answer** is "*Researchers are using satellite tracking devices to study the bird's migratory patterns."*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: **The Sapphire-winged Warbler is the largest bird species in the avian kingdom. This is not mentioned in the passage.
 
• **Option 2: **Schools on the island organise annual bird-watching competitions. This statement is not found in the passage.
 
• **Option 3:** The Sapphire-winged Warbler is the only bird species on the tropical island. The passage does not claim that it is the only bird species on the island.
